text:
Maya (Mktg): Heads-up — webinar landing page is live. Need final X + LinkedIn copy + hero crop by EOD so Liam can schedule. We want 2 hook variants for A/B on LinkedIn.
Sam (Creative): Uploaded hero + 16:9 and square crops to Drive: https://drive.redwood/rez/webinar-hero. Square is slightly tight on the logo, can tweak.
Liam (Social): Got it. Preferred post windows: X at 10:30 PT, LinkedIn at 11:00 PT. For X we should do short hook + 1 hashtag, LinkedIn can be longer w/ bullet CTA.
Devon (Demand): For LinkedIn A/B: Variant A — product-first benchmark stat; Variant B — customer outcome + CTA. I'll prepare two short lead magnets as hooks.
Maya (Mktg): Perfect. Also we need two follow-up messages to post 24h after the live webinar (one highlight, one on-demand CTA). Who owns engagement follow-ups?
Devon (Demand): I can own follow-ups for the first 24h. Will monitor top replies and escalate to Sam for creative if we need visuals.
Sam (Creative): Quick note: can we send the short CTA text I should overlay on the square asset? Options: "Join live — spots limited" or "See the benchmark in action". Pick one.
Maya (Mktg): Use "See the benchmark in action" for LinkedIn, "Join live" for X. Keep visuals consistent.
Liam (Social): Scheduling snippet I'm putting into Buffer:
```
POST X @ 10:30PT
> "Wondering why tokens matter? 40% lower cost/latency in our new inference tests. Join our webinar — Thu 11AM PT. #inference"
SCHEDULE LinkedIn @ 11:00PT
> "Benchmark results are in: 40% lower per-token cost without accuracy loss. Join our free webinar on Thu 11AM PT to see the tests, tools, and a live demo. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar"
```
Sam (Creative): Done — exported two hero variants with CTA overlay v1 & v2. Link: https://drive.redwood/rez/webinar-hero/final_v1_v2.zip
Maya (Mktg): Thanks. Liam, when you schedule please tag the post with the webinar event and add UTM params: utm_source=x_social or utm_source=linkedin.
Liam (Social): Will do. Also adding an internal note to boost the LinkedIn post if CTR < 1.5% in first 6 hours.
EngageBot: Calendar event created: "Webinar — Inference Benchmarks" Thu 11:00 PT. Attendees: @Maya, @Devon, @Liam.
Maya (Mktg): Final ask — Devon, can you draft 2 short reply templates to use for high-value replies (ask for company size and use-case)? Need them before the post goes live.
Devon (Demand): On it. I'll drop them here in 45m. :thumbsup:
Maya (Mktg): Awesome. If anything blocks asset tweaks ping me. Thanks team :rocket:
